card.name: The word signs after monitor for
card.fires_on: The word "signs" right after "evaluate patients for" or "monitor for" in drug interaction instructions. Also weakly on "present" after "may be" in hypersensitivity text.

modes.label: The phrase monitor for signs
modes.description: "signs" follows an instruction to evaluate or monitor patients for something, before a named problem such as worsening renal function.

modes.label: Manifestations present
modes.description: "present" ends a clause about early symptoms that may be seen.
modes.example: such as fever or lymphadenopathy, may be<< present>> even though rash is not evident.

card.plain: It responds to the word "signs" when the label tells readers to watch patients for signs of a problem.
